scope_limit: The exact current complete parameter-vector and pre-projection process-covariance pair is always present among nine candidates. Both labels switch together at days sixteen and thirty-one, and all nine trials end with a different origin pair. Each fifteen-day stage excludes its first five days from identification scoring. The seven-day forecast remains in the third stage. Results do not establish behavior for absent candidates, unsynchronized switches, other switch intervals, transition probabilities, forcing errors, observation strengths, or real basins.
